card.title: What Are We Now?
card.instruction: Find out how someone defines the relationship without directly asking for a label.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For your sister's wedding, should I book us one room or two?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Double bed, then, or shall I ask for twins?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Twins. I don't want to confuse things.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. At breakfast, do I sit with your family or wait for you in the lobby?

mechanism: A probes the relationship through room, bed and family-seating logistics without asking its name.
confusable: Unlike ordinary booking questions, each choice must expose a relational boundary the prior practical answer leaves unclear.
comparison: D78-a moves from accommodation to public family inclusion; D78-b moves from towel use to whether a personal place remains afterward.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
